children.description: The western mountain coati or western dwarf coati (Nasuella olivacea) is a small procyonid, found in cloud forest and páramo at altitudes of in the Andes of Colombia and Ecuador.

children.name: Nasuella meridensis
children.description: The eastern mountain coati or eastern dwarf coati (Nasuella meridensis) is a small procyonid found in cloud forest and páramo at elevations of in the Andes of western Venezuela.
